question_text: When an object $O$ is placed on the principal axis of a thin convex lens of focal length $f_1$, it forms a real image at a distance $V_1$ with a linear magnification of $m_1$. When the same object is placed at a distance $u$ from a thin convex lens of focal length $f_2$, it forms a real image at a distance $V_2$ and the magnification $m_2$. If $V_1 = V_2 = V$ and $f_1 = f_2 = f$, which of the following conditions will satisfy the conditions?
